source_name: ÚVO – Register osôb so zákazom účasti vo verejnom obstarávaní (debarment register)
why_relevant: Statutory register (§183 Act 343/2015) of economic operators debarred from public procurement by final decision — the sanction endpoint of bid-rigging and misrepresentation cases. Directly relevant when screening SK bidders/partners in payments and IT integration.

source_name: ÚVO – Podávanie námietok / odvolaní (e-service & procedural documentation)
why_relevant: Defines who may challenge, deadlines, deposits (kaucia) and the procedural path. Needed to interpret the decision corpus correctly and to judge feasibility of challenging a SK banking tender.

source_name: Uvostat – Zoznam rozhodnutí o námietkach (independent ÚVO data aggregator)
why_relevant: Third-party mirror/aggregator of ÚVO data presenting objection decisions in a browsable, cross-linked form (procurer–supplier relations, contract register, bulletin). Far easier to query at scale than the official site and useful as a redundancy channel.

source_name: NKÚ SR – Najvyšší kontrolný úrad Slovenskej republiky (supreme audit institution)
why_relevant: SAI auditing state, municipal and EU funds. Its procurement audits have documented overpricing and rule breaches; audit reports name entities, contract subjects and amounts, exposing banking/payment service contracts of ministries, municipalities and state enterprises retrospectively.

source_name: NKÚ SR – Zoznam aktuálnych kontrol (list of ongoing audits)
why_relevant: Forward-looking: shows which entities and themes NKÚ is auditing right now, with evidence numbers (evidenčné číslo KA). Lets you anticipate which public bodies' payment/banking arrangements will be scrutinised and when reports land.

source_name: NR SR parliamentary document library – NKÚ reports tabled in parliament
why_relevant: NKÚ annual and thematic audit reports are submitted to the National Council and stored as downloadable PDFs there. Useful as an alternative/archival copy when nku.gov.sk restructures URLs, and it captures the parliamentary debate around findings.

source_name: PMÚ SR – Prehľad rozhodnutí (Antimonopoly Office decisions overview)
why_relevant: Full-text decisions of the Slovak competition authority, including bid-rigging (kolúzia vo verejnom obstarávaní) cartels. Decisions disclose tender identities, bid prices, communications between bidders and fines/debarments — the deepest retrospective view of how a tender was actually run.

source_name: PMÚ SR – Transparency portal (transparency.antimon.gov.sk)
why_relevant: PMÚ's dedicated document-publication portal with advanced search and year filtering — the practical machine-facing entry point for its decision corpus, better structured than the CMS news pages.

source_name: PMÚ SR – Bid rigging vo verejnom obstarávaní (thematic hub + methodology PDFs)
why_relevant: Authority's own explanation of detection indicators, leniency programme and enforcement statistics. Provides the vocabulary and red-flag taxonomy to apply when scanning SK banking/payments tenders, and links to enforcement news with fines and 3-year procurement bans.

source_name: Slov-Lex – Súdne rozhodnutia všeobecných súdov SR (official case-law database)
why_relevant: Official state publication of court decisions (mandatory under §82a Act 757/2004). This is where administrative-court judgments reviewing ÚVO and PMÚ decisions on procurement disputes are authoritatively published, with ECLI identifiers.

source_name: Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR – Súdy a rozhodnutia
why_relevant: Ministry of Justice gateway to court decision search and to the register of finality/enforceability certificates (Register doložiek právoplatností) — needed to confirm whether a procurement judgment is final before drawing conclusions from it.

source_name: Judikáty.info – Slovak case-law aggregator (NSS SR / NS SR / správne súdy)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator with far better faceted search than the official portals: pre-built topic pages for 'Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie', 'verejné obstarávanie' and 'správna žaloba' across the Supreme Administrative Court, Supreme Court and regional/administrative courts, with legal headnotes (právne vety).

source_name: Verejné obstarávanie v praxi (vovpraxi.sk) – Námietky keyword register
why_relevant: Practitioner publication tracking ÚVO decision practice and legislative change by keyword. Good early interpretation layer on new objection decisions and a snowball source for terminology and named cases.

source_name: Transparency International Slovensko – public procurement analyses
why_relevant: Watchdog analyses and rankings that surface irregular tenders, single-bidder rates and disputed awards, often before or instead of formal remedies. Useful as a lead-generation channel pointing to specific contested contracts to look up in ÚVO/court registers.

source_name: data.slovensko.sk – Slovak open data portal (authority datasets)
why_relevant: National open-data catalogue that already hosts datasets published by antimon.gov.sk and other authorities; the place to check whether ÚVO/NKÚ/PMÚ expose machine-readable decision or audit datasets instead of requiring scraping.

source_name: Your Europe / e-Justice – EU-level explainer on requesting review of a SK procurement procedure
why_relevant: Confirms ÚVO as the designated SK review body under the EU Remedies Directives and gives the EN/SK bilingual framing needed to map SK remedy terminology to EU concepts; e-Justice mirrors the national case-law access points.

source_name: Národný katalóg otvorených dát (data.slovensko.sk) — ÚVO dataset list
source_subtype: national open data catalogue / dataset index
why_relevant: Official national open-data catalogue entry enumerating the Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie (ÚVO) datasets, including the Vestník verejného obstarávania (procurement bulletin) releases. This is the canonical machine-readable index of Slovak procurement open data and the entry point for bulk historical notice harvesting relevant to banking/payments tenders.

source_name: data.slovensko.sk SPARQL endpoint (National Open Data Catalogue API)
why_relevant: The national catalogue exposes its metadata as a SPARQL endpoint (DCAT-AP-SK 3.0), i.e. https://data.slovensko.sk/api/sparql?query={...}. This is the programmatic way to discover every procurement-related dataset and its distributions without scraping HTML, and to detect newly published Vestník issues automatically.

source_name: data.gov.sk (legacy CKAN open data portal)
why_relevant: Predecessor national portal, CKAN-based, still hosting procurement-relevant datasets including the Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) change batches and ÚVO datasets. CKAN gives a well-known REST API (package_search / package_show) that is far easier to automate than the newer portal, and it preserves historical dataset revisions.

source_name: Ekosystém.Slovensko.Digital — Otvorené dáta (SQL dumps)
why_relevant: Civil-society re-publication of the whole Slovak state-register corpus in cleaned, queryable form: CRZ contracts from 2011, register of legal entities (RPO v2), obchodný vestník, accounting records. Weekly SQL dumps (Sunday 04:00) mean the entire contract corpus can be loaded locally and joined to company identifiers (IČO) — exactly the supplier-side analysis the official portals cannot do.

source_name: UVOstat.sk — public procurement in analysable form
why_relevant: Re-publishes the entire ÚVO bulletin plus CRZ in a browsable, historicised, entity-linked form: profiles per contracting authority, per supplier, and per CPV code, with derived metrics (Index kvality, Index úspešnosti) and links between authorities and suppliers. Preserves notices after they are moved/delisted on the official portal, and is the fastest way to map which suppliers win banking/payments-related CPV categories.

source_name: UVOstat API documentation (GitHub: MiroBabic/uvostat_api)
why_relevant: Public documentation of UVOstat's API: endpoints, filter parameters, JSON output shape and the ApiToken header requirement (401 without a valid token). This is the technical key to collecting UVOstat data lawfully and efficiently instead of scraping, and it also documents the underlying identifier scheme.

source_name: Open Contracting Data Standard (schema + tooling)
why_relevant: Defines the data model, extensions, validation and JSON<->CSV conversion tooling used by the Slovak OCDS publication. Needed to interpret field semantics and to normalise Slovak notices into a comparable schema; also documents API-design guidance used by publishers.

source_name: TRANSPAREX — hodnotenie obstarávateľov / T-index
why_relevant: Specialised Slovak information system built on automated processing of the procurement bulletin: supplier commercial-behaviour profiles, buyer purchasing-behaviour profiles, conflict-of-interest checks, 240k+ verified references, and the T-index competition rating covering ~3,900 institutions. Directly answers 'who competes and who wins' for a given category, including bank-adjacent IT and services buyers.
